Open the app on your phone

This QR opens the staff app. It is not an admission ticket and gives no access to customer information.

Open Ringside Door →

iPhone / iPad

  1. Open Ringside Door in Safari.
  2. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. If offered, enable Open as Web App.
  3. Tap Add. Open the Ringside Door icon from your home screen.

Android

  1. Open Ringside Door in Chrome.
  2. Open the browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
  3. Confirm installation and open Ringside Door.

Sign in and scan

  1. Use your own invited staff account and authenticator.
  2. Select the event assigned by the organiser.
  3. Allow camera access when you choose Open ticket camera.
  4. Scan the attendee’s ticket QR, compare the name with their ID, then tap Admit attendee.

A second scan shows Already used. Internet access is required for admission. Installation alone does not authorise a staff member.
